title: Syrian Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry dish made with marinated chicken, bell peppers, and onions, inspired by Syrian cuisine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
